einzeiler: Trial updates on Lindsay Clancy and Tupac's murder, plus an expert guide to extradition.
kurzfassung: The podcast covers the high-profile murder trial of Lindsay Clancy, where jurors remain deadlocked after weeks of deliberations. It also examines the sentencing of a California woman for murdering her firefighter wife, alongside legal roundups on the Tupac Shakur murder verdict, David's case, and Brian Kohberger's appeal. Finally, a former federal prosecutor explains how international extradition works in fugitive cases.
stichpunkte: Jurors deliberate in the murder trial of former nurse Lindsay Clancy amidst intense public attention and defense arguments focused on postpartum psychosis.
Yolanda Marodi receives a 36-year-to-life sentence for murdering her firefighter wife, Rebecca Marodi, after fleeing to Mexico.
A Las Vegas jury finds former gang leader Dwayne Davis guilty of first-degree murder in the 1996 killing of Tupac Shakur.
Singer David pleads not guilty to murder charges in Los Angeles, while his initial defense team requests to withdraw from the case.
Idaho student killer Brian Kohberger files motions to change venue and disqualify the trial judge.
Former federal prosecutor Jacques Semelman details the legal mechanics, treaties, and hurdles involved in international extradition.

clips.text: The defense attorney used side-by-side family photos and medical bottles to argue that poor pharmaceutical treatments and medical negligence transformed a devoted mother into someone suffering from a severe psychotic breakdown.

The victim's mother delivered an emotional condemnation of the killer during sentencing, describing the permanent trauma of discovering her daughter's body while vowing not to let the perpetrator's darkness consume her.

clips.hook: Guilty verdict in Tupac's murder trial
clips.text: Following a swift jury deliberation, a guilty verdict of first-degree murder with a deadly weapon was handed down, prompting tears and embraced hands among the victim's family members in the courtroom.
Legal representatives for a convicted murderer filed formal requests seeking both a change of venue and the removal of the presiding judge on the grounds of perceived partiality.

beschreibung:
In Massachusetts, a jury is deliberating the fate of Lindsay Clancy, a mother who says she was suffering from postpartum psychosis when she killed her three children. After California fire captain Rebecca Marodi was stabbed to death by her wife, Yolanda, investigators uncovered Yolanda's troubling past. In Dateline Round Up, there's a verdict in the murder trial of Duane "Keefe D" Davis, accused of orchestrating the 1996 Las Vegas shooting that killed rap legend Tupac Shakur. Courtroom surprise in the case of singer D4vd, accused of murdering 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez. And updates in the case of Bryan Kohberger, the man convicted of killing four University of Idaho students. Plus, expert breaks down the extradition process.
This episode discusses suicide. If you or someone you know is in crisis, call the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline at 988 or visit 988lifeline.org for more resources.
